title: デビュー戦の後に・幕開け、ここから

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober trembles with joy after she manages to display her full power in the race. She also thanks everyone in the waiting room for their support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following her debut, public opinion on Mejiro Dober rises rapidly and all eyes turn to her as the new hope for the Mejiro family!
